sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
வில்லை ஏந்தி நின்றானே விஜயராகவன் தந்தை
சொல்லை மீறாத் தனயன் என்னும் பேருடனே
sections.translit:
villai Endhi nindRAnE vijayarAghavan thandhai
sollai mIrAth thanayan ennum pErudanE
sections.en: Lord Rama, known as Vijaya Raghavan, carried the unique bow on his shoulders. He was ready to depart to the forest with his good name intact as an obedient son, one who would never cross his father’s words or orders.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
இல்லை என்று சொல்லாமலே இல்லாளோடு
கல்லை மண்ணைத் தாண்டிக் கால்நடந்தானே
sections.translit:
illai endRu sollAmalE illALOdu
kallai maNNaith thANdik kAlnadandhAnE
sections.en: He walked accompanied by his wife, not denying her expectations, and crossed a hard path full of stones and sand.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
முல்லைமேல் உறங்கும் ராஜன் முள்ளையும்
புல்லையும் துச்சமென்றானே அஞ்சும் நெஞ்சினள்
எல்லை இலாத் துயர் எதிர்கொள்ள அசுரர்
மல்லை லகுவில் வெல்ல சகாயமாய்ச் சென்றானே
sections.translit:
mullaimEl uRangum rAjan muLLaiyum
pullaiyum thucchamendRAnE anjum nenjinaL
ellai ilAth thuyar edhirkoLLa asurar
mallai laguvil vella sagAyamAy chendRAnE
sections.en: Though he was from the ruling class and used to all forms of luxury – like sleeping on a bed strewn with soft jasmine flowers– he did not care for all the thorns and coarse blades of grass on the way. Rama also knew that the gentle and timid Sita had to put up with endless suffering during the journey. Rama, determined as he was, moved forward effortlessly to face fighting the demons in the forest.
